title: Concept: CORS allows every HTTP method from any origin
description: A CORS policy grants every HTTP method to every origin. Method wildcards are frequently added to stop preflight failures during development and then shipped unchanged; they turn a narrowly scoped API into one that accepts cross-origin PUT or DELETE if those routes exist.
applicability: HTTP APIs that answer CORS preflight requests.
risk: Cross-origin method surface widened for any origin; LOW severity.
